about_short_description.short_description: Lightly is a data curation company for machine learning that helps companies build better models through better data.

product.name: LightlyOne
product.description: A data selection and viewing tool that provides insights into datasets and helps define optimal data selection strategies for machine learning.

product.name: LightlyEdge
product.description: An on-device data capturing solution that identifies and collects only the most valuable data directly on edge devices.

product.name: LightlyTrain
product.description: A self-supervised pretraining tool that enables training of vision models on unlabeled data to reduce labeling costs and improve model performance.

product.name: Autolabeling Service
product.description: A service that automates labeling of datasets using active learning, few-shot learning, and rule-based techniques to reduce manual annotation effort.
